coordination.configured_by: root agent via app tool after explicit user authorization
coordination.resume_rule: Inspect live agents and latest receipts before dispatch; preserve active batches and permit only one network worker.

tasks.goal: Audit all sidebar menu observations against the accepted v8 derivative and extract evidence-backed dependency gaps.
acceptance: Count conservation for 588 in-scope observations and 653 excluded observations
Every reported gap has a local evidence pointer
Current page, resources and interaction states are separate
tasks.stop: 25 minute batch; report infrastructure failure or required interface/scope change

tasks.goal: Recheck the first 30 unique Karazhan targets whose previous attempt ended before a source HTTP response.
acceptance: Capture time comes only from valid Memento
Payload byte length, SHA256, MIME and image decode are independently recorded
All candidates have classified results or explicit not-requested reasons
Only sanitized receipts are suitable for public tracking
tasks.stop: 429 or 503; five consecutive transport/TLS failures; deadline or any resource limit

tasks.goal: After at least fifteen minutes of cooldown, test one previously decoded JPEG control before choosing any new recovery batch.
acceptance: Actual Memento is independent of requested timestamp
tasks.stop: Control failure; any limit or 429/503. Do not rerun the thirty-target batch after a failed control.
